title: 中考英语精编模拟卷（二）
source: 作者结合备考经验，按中考考点原创出题，短文均为原创
note: 按全国中考常见题型原创，文章均为新写，可打印

items.stem: There is ____ "u" in the word "useful", and it is ____ useful word.
items.exp: 字母 u 读音以元音开头，用 an；useful 以辅音 /j/ 开头，用 a。

items.stem: Mr. Brown is strict ____ his students, but he is very kind to them.
items.exp: be strict with sb. 对某人严格。

items.stem: —Whose dictionary is this? —It ____ be Tom's. His name is on it.
items.exp: 名字写在上面，有把握的肯定推测用 must。

items.stem: Neither my parents nor my sister ____ at home this weekend.
items.exp: neither...nor... 连接主语时，谓语就近与 my sister 一致，用 is。

items.stem: The more you practise, ____ you will speak English.
items.exp: the + 比较级, the + 比较级，表示“越……就越……”。

items.stem: —Have you finished your project yet? —Not yet. I ____ it now.
items.exp: now 提示正在做，用现在进行时。

items.stem: It's important for us ____ a good habit of reading every day.
items.exp: It's + adj. + for sb. + to do sth. 句型。

items.stem: The teacher asked us ____ in the library.
items.exp: ask sb. not to do sth. 要求某人不要做某事。

items.stem: —How was your trip to the countryside? —Wonderful! I've never seen ____ beautiful scenery before.
items.exp: scenery 为不可数名词，用 such + adj. + 不可数名词。

items.stem: Many old houses in the town ____ into small museums since 2020.
items.kp: 现在完成时的被动语态
items.exp: since 2020 用现在完成时；房子“被改造成”，用被动语态。

items.stem: You'd better ____ your phone when you are crossing the road.
items.exp: had better 的否定为 had better not do sth.。

items.stem: I will call you as soon as I ____ in Beijing.
items.exp: as soon as 引导的时间状语从句用一般现在时表示将来。

items.stem: This is the museum ____ we visited last month.
items.exp: 先行词 museum 指物，在从句中作 visited 的宾语，用 which（也可用 that）。

items.stem: —I'm sorry I broke your cup. —____ I have another one.
items.exp: 回应道歉，表示“没关系”。

items.stem: —Do you know ____? —Next Friday, I think.
options: when the exam will be over
when will the exam be over
items.exp: 答语是时间，问“什么时候结束”，宾语从句用陈述语序。

sections.title: The Note on the Desk
sections.passage:
Last winter, I had a very bad cold and had to stay at home for a week. When I went back to school, I was (16) about my lessons. I had missed so much!
When I sat down at my desk, I found a note (17) it. It said, "Welcome back! We copied the notes for you. If you have any (18) , just ask us." Under the words were the (19) of five classmates.

items.exp: 错过很多课，担心功课。
纸条放在课桌上。
有问题就问我们。
纸条下方是五位同学的名字。
课后轮流帮我补课。
耐心地讲解数学题。

be thankful to sb. 感激某人。
offer to help 主动提出帮忙。

groups.label: A
groups.title: Green Week Notice
groups.passage:
Green Week Is Coming!
Date: April 20–26
Monday: Bring your old books and clothes to the school hall. They will be given to children in need.
Wednesday: Join the "No Plastic Lunch" challenge. Bring your own lunch box and cup.
Friday: Plant trees on the hill behind the school. Meet at the school gate at 3:30 p.m. Wear comfortable shoes.
Prizes: The class with the most points will win a trip to the science museum.
For more information, ask Ms. Li in Room 302.

items.stem: On which day can students give away their old clothes?
items.exp: 周一把旧书旧衣服送到学校礼堂。

items.stem: What should students bring on Wednesday?
options: A lunch box and a cup.
items.exp: Bring your own lunch box and cup.

items.stem: What can the winning class get?
items.exp: 获胜班级可去科技馆参观。

items.stem: Who should students ask for more information?
items.exp: ask Ms. Li in Room 302。

groups.label: B
groups.title: The Boy Who Loved Maps
groups.passage:
When Chen Yu was eight, his grandfather gave him an old world map. Every evening, Chen Yu lay on the floor and looked at it for hours. He learned the names of rivers, mountains and countries by heart.
At school, he was not good at many subjects, but he always got full marks in geography. His teacher noticed his interest and suggested he draw maps of his own town. Chen Yu walked through every street with a notebook. It took him three months to finish the first map.
Later, his map was used by the town's tourist center. Visitors loved it because it showed small shops and hidden gardens that were not on other maps. "A good map is not just lines," Chen Yu said. "It tells people what makes a place special."
Today, Chen Yu studies geography at a university. He still carries a notebook everywhere he goes.

items.stem: What did Chen Yu's grandfather give him?
items.exp: 祖父送给他一张旧世界地图。

items.stem: Who suggested Chen Yu draw maps of his town?
items.exp: 老师注意到他的兴趣并提出建议。

items.stem: Why did visitors love Chen Yu's map?
options: It was drawn by a child.
It showed places not on other maps.
items.exp: 地图标出了别的地图上没有的小店和花园。

items.stem: What can we learn from the story?
options: Geography is the most important subject.
Interest can lead a person to success.
items.exp: 兴趣引导他一路走到大学学地理。

sections.title: Planning a Weekend
sections.passage:
A: Hi, Mike. (34)
B: Not much. Maybe I'll just stay at home and watch TV.
A: How about going hiking with us? (35)
B: That sounds great! Where are you going?
A: To Green Hill. (36)
B: How long does it take to get there?
A: About forty minutes by bus. (37)
B: OK. What should I bring?
A: Some water and snacks. (38)
B: Got it. See you on Saturday!
choices: The view from the top is amazing.
What are you going to do this weekend?
We'll meet at the bus stop at 8:00.
Don't forget your hat. It'll be sunny.
My brother and I are going on Saturday.
I don't like hiking at all.

items.exp: B 回答周末没什么安排，所以 A 问周末打算做什么。
邀请对方一起，说明“我和哥哥周六去”。
介绍目的地的美景。
说完路程后约定集合时间和地点。
继续提醒要带的东西：帽子。

sections.title: A Special Teacher
sections.passage:
Our new music teacher, Ms. Zhao, is very (39) (interest). On the first day, she didn't ask us to sing. (40) (instead), she asked us to listen to the sounds around us: birds, rain and even our own (41) (heartbeat).
"Music is everywhere," she said. "You just need to listen (42) (careful)." Then she taught us to make simple instruments (43) bottles and boxes. Everyone was (44) (excite).
Since then, music class (45) (become) our favorite. Last month, our class (46) (give) a concert with the instruments we made. Many parents came to watch it. Ms. Zhao told us that the most important thing is (47) (enjoy) music, not to be perfect. I think she is one of the (48) (good) teachers I have ever met.

items.exp: 描述人“有趣的”，用 interesting。
句首表示“相反，而是”，首字母大写。
our own 指全班同学各自的心跳，用复数。
修饰动词 listen，用副词。
用瓶子和盒子做乐器，make...with/from/out of 均可。
人感到兴奋用 excited。
since then 用现在完成时。
last month 用一般过去时。
与后文 not to be perfect 对应，用不定式。
one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词。

sections.prompt:
你的英国笔友 Tom 来信说，他下个月要来你所在的城市旅游，想了解当地有什么值得去的地方和推荐的美食。请给他回一封邮件，内容包括：1. 推荐一个值得去的地方并说明理由；2. 推荐一种当地美食；3. 给他一条出行建议（如天气、交通等）。要求：80—100 词，开头和结尾已给出，不计入总词数，不出现真实姓名和校名。
Dear Tom,
I'm glad to hear that you are coming to my city next month.
______
Yours,
Li Hua
points: 给出一条合理的出行建议
语言准确、衔接自然、格式正确
sections.sample:
Dear Tom,
I'm glad to hear that you are coming to my city next month.
First, I strongly recommend the West Lake Park. It's not only beautiful but also full of history. You can take a boat on the lake and enjoy the view of the hills.
As for food, you must try our rice noodles. They are a little spicy but really delicious, and you can find them in almost every street.
By the way, it often rains here in May, so remember to bring an umbrella. Taking the subway is the easiest way to get around.
I can't wait to see you!
Yours,
Li Hua
sections.exp: 书信体：先写推荐地点和理由，再写美食，最后给建议；用 First, As for, By the way 串联。
